source.quote: Shares may be issued to or held by an investor only after the investor has passed know-your-customer and anti-money-laundering checks and is not listed on any sanctions list.

rules.rationale: Issuance is a mint; recipient must have passed KYC and AML and be sanctions-clear.

source.quote: An investor must verify their identity with a government-issued identity document before shares are issued to, transferred to or redeemed by that investor.

rules.rationale: Issuance is a mint; recipient identity must be verified first.

source.quote: The Transfer Agent shall issue shares to an investor only after the Issuer has accepted the investor's subscription and the investor's payment has been received by the Issuer's custodian.

rules.rationale: Issuance is a mint; requires accepted subscription and confirmed payment receipt.

source.quote: An investor must verify their identity with a government-issued identity document before shares are issued to, transferred to or redeemed by that investor.

rules.rationale: Redemption is a burn; redeeming investor identity must be verified first.

source.quote: The Transfer Agent shall redeem shares only when the Issuer has authorized the redemption and the investor holds enough shares to cover it.

rules.rationale: Redemption is a burn; requires Issuer authorization and sufficient share balance.

source.quote: Shares may be transferred only to an investor who meets the conditions of Sections 2 and 3.

rules.rationale: Section 6 imports Section 2 (KYC, AML, sanctions) and Section 3 (identity) as recipient conditions for every transfer.

terms.name: netAssetValue

source.quote: The net asset value is USD 1.00 per share.

terms.rationale: Per-share price the venue applies to subscriptions (mint) and redemptions (burn).

terms.name: subscriptionFee

source.quote: The subscription fee is 25 basis points and the redemption fee is 25 basis points.

terms.rationale: Fee rate charged on subscription (mint); a stated price, enforceable like the NAV.

terms.name: redemptionFee

source.quote: The subscription fee is 25 basis points and the redemption fee is 25 basis points.

terms.rationale: Fee rate charged on redemption (burn); a stated price, enforceable like the NAV.

terms.name: supplyCap

source.quote: The total number of outstanding shares shall not exceed 1000000 shares.

terms.rationale: Hard ceiling on outstanding shares the venue must enforce against minting.

unresolved.description: Effective Date "September 1, 2026" is a contract date, not a venue-enforced price, cap or period.
"Each share is recorded by the Transfer Agent." is a record-keeping obligation, not a mint, burn or transfer gate.
Receipt of "the investor's payment" by "the Issuer's custodian" is a deposit obligation; deposit is not enforced here, only its outcome (depositConfirmed) gates mint.
"Any other transfer is void." is a legal consequence, not an on-chain effect; the venue can only reject transfers failing the transfer rule.
Fee collection mechanics (payer, timing, asset, deducted from shares or cash) are unspecified; rates are terms, collection cannot be compiled.
Enforcing the cap as a mint precondition needs a supply-level comparison; the fact vocabulary has none, so the gate cannot be a rule condition.
